local.entry_method: Automatic model delegation or `/agent Praxys Orchestrator` in Copilot CLI.

cloud.entry_method: Explicit custom-agent assignment for agent-ready issues or manual Praxys Orchestrator selection.

limitations.behavior: Use the same enumerated classification and deterministic Work Contract; prose and intermediate reasoning may still differ.
limitations.rationale: Copilot model selection and sampling are runtime concerns outside the repository contract.

limitations.behavior: Run the scheduled and manual live parity check; block affected loops when required MCP tools are missing.
limitations.rationale: Cloud MCP settings live in GitHub repository settings rather than the git tree.

limitations.behavior: Do not use production authentication, provider connections, sync, plan mutation, or high-impact operations from portable agents.
limitations.rationale: Cloud parity intentionally uses a read-only synthetic Praxys profile.

limitations.behavior: Leave the PR draft and require a user-approved local foreground WeChat DevTools pass.
limitations.rationale: Tencent provides no supported headless or no-focus simulator mode.

limitations.behavior: Portable agents ignore user-level or local-only MCP tools unless a task explicitly leaves the portable path.
limitations.rationale: Local Copilot may expose Azure, Statsig, dev-test, credentials, or personal tools that Cloud does not share.

limitations.behavior: Agent-ready issues are routed automatically; other cloud tasks must explicitly select Praxys Orchestrator.
limitations.rationale: Not every Product, Science, Design, Runtime, Incident, or Meta/Eval signal has a safe repository event trigger.

limitations.behavior: Treat changed custom agents and setup steps as inactive until merged to the default branch, then run a disposable Cloud smoke task.
limitations.rationale: GitHub Cloud agent loads repository custom-agent and setup configuration from the default branch.

limitations.behavior: Use the common isolated browser for public sources, record the actual verification level, and block strong conclusions when relevant full text is unavailable.
limitations.rationale: Network availability, publisher access, and paywalls are external to the repository and portable agents do not inherit personal browser sessions.

limitations.behavior: Use the repository mediator for manifest-coordinated calls in instrument or shadow mode. Only its explicit kill switch rejects a mediated launch; ordinary would-reject and unavailable-state results remain non-blocking.
limitations.rationale: The repository can cooperatively mediate its own agent manifests but cannot intercept platform-native or otherwise unmediated agent invocations.
